chunks.heading: Does Lighthouse support offline mode?
chunks.text: Offline read access is available only in the mobile apps. The desktop and web apps require an active connection to load or save changes.

chunks.heading: Why am I hitting rate limit errors?
chunks.text: You are exceeding your plan's allowed API requests per minute; see the API rate limits table in the pricing documentation for your plan's exact limit.

chunks.heading: How long are webhook retries attempted?
chunks.text: A failing webhook endpoint is retried for up to 24 hours using exponential backoff before Lighthouse stops trying.

chunks.heading: Can I export all of my data?
chunks.text: Yes, from Settings > Data Export you can download a CSV export containing your tasks, projects, and comments.

chunks.heading: Is there a public status page?
chunks.text: status.lighthouse.example shows current uptime and a history of past incidents.
